* Total Length: 2.7m
* Indoor Only

CAUTION:
• This is not a toy, keep away from children
and pets during use and assembly.
• Do not operate in packaging.
• Keep away from heat source or naked flame.
• Do not submerge in water or any other liquids.
• Check for damage before use, do not use
if bulbs or cable are damaged.
• Do not stretch, twist or trap cable.
• This light set is for indoor use only.
• Ensure cable is placed such that no trip,
entanglement or strangulation hazards are
likely to occur.
• Do not attempt to replace the “non-
replaceable” bulbs.
• This product is for decorative purposes only, it
is not suitable for household illumination.

BEFORE FIRST USE: Carefully remove the product from the
packaging taking care not to twist or tangle the cable. To insert
batteries, unscrew the hook end lid of the battery compartment by
turning in an anti-clockwise direction indicated by the arrow. Using
the satin loop carefully pull and slide out the battery holder (the
battery holder is not removeable). Insert 2 x 1.5V AA batteries
ensuring you follow the diagrams marked on the holder. Carefully
refit the battery holder and secure the lid making sure the
waterproof seal is correctly seated. Careful not to twist or strain the
wires of the lighting chain during this operation.
Press the on/off button to turn the lights on or off.

BATTERY WARNING! Batteries should only be inserted or
changed by an adult. Do not use rechargeable batteries.
Non-rechargeable batteries are not to be recharged. Do not mix
alkaline, standard (carbon-zinc) or rechargeable (nickel–cadmium)
batteries. Never mix old batteries with new batteries (replace all
batteries at the same time). Be sure to insert batteries with the
correct polarities and always follow product and battery
manufacturers’ instructions. Remove batteries from the product before
extended storage. Always remove old or exhausted batteries from
the product. The supply terminals are not to be short-circuited.
Check that the contact surfaces are clean and bright before
installing batteries. Do not bury or burn batteries. Recycle used
batteries responsibly. Do not dispose of in household waste.
Uses non-replaceable LED bulbs.

products.variantName: Prestige Battery Operated LED Snowflake Window Light 27cm - Multi
products.sourceDescription:
Brighten up your home this winter with the Prestige Battery Operated LED Snowflake Window Light, featuring 24 dazzling LEDs for a cosy indoor glow without the hassle of wires. Perfect for adding festive charm to any window!

* Indoor only
* Window light
* Battery operated
* 24x bright LEDs
* Requires 2 x 1.5V AA Batteries (Not Included).
* Lead Wire: 0.3m

This is not a toy, keep away from children and pets during use and assembly. Do
not operate in packaging. Keep away from heat source or naked flame. Do not
submerge in water or any other liquids. Check for damage before use, do not
use if bulbs or cable are damaged. Do not stretch, twist or trap cable. Ensure
cable is placed such that no trip, entanglement or strangulation hazards are
likely to occur. Do not attempt to replace the “non-replaceable” bulbs. This
product is for decorative purposes only, it is not suitable for household
illumination.

**BEFORE FIRST USE**: Carefully remove the product from the packaging taking
care not to twist or tangle the cable. To insert batteries, unclip the cover from
the battery compartment. Insert 2 x 1.5V AA batteries ensuring you follow the
diagrams marked on the holder. Carefully refit the battery cover and secure.
Take care not to twist or strain the wire.

**BATTERY WARNING!** Batteries should only be inserted or changed by an adult.
Do not use rechargeable batteries. Non-rechargeable batteries are not to be
recharged. Do not mix alkaline, standard (carbon-zinc) or rechargeable
(nickel–cadmium) batteries. Never mix old batteries with new batteries (replace
all batteries at the same time). Be sure to insert batteries with the correct
polarities and always follow product and battery manufacturers’ instructions.
Remove batteries from product before extended storage. Always remove old or
exhausted batteries from the product. The supply terminals are not to be short
circuited. Check that the contact surfaces are clean and bright before installing
batteries. Do not bury or burn batteries. Waste electrical products should not
be disposed of with household waste. Please recycle where facilities exist.
Check with your Local Authority or retailer for recycling advice.

products.sourceDescription:
A crowded Christmas tree still needs lights to complete its look. Prestige Lighting 50 LED Multifunction/Timer Lights are a perfect fit to light up your tree without taking up too much space, while giving you less hassle with its Timer feature. The lights are great for smaller objects that also can be included in home decoration like tables and bushes!

* Available in three different colours
* 8 different sequences
* 5.9m length
* 50 non-replaceable bulbs
* Timer function- 6 hours on/ 18 hours off
* Memory function
* Battery operated (requires 3 x 1.5V AA)
* Energy saving
* Suitable for indoor and outdoor use
* LED non-replaceable. Chain rated voltage and wattage 4.5V/0.225W

* This is not a toy, keep away from children and pets during use and assembly 
* Do not operate in packaging
* Keep away from heat source or naked flame
* Do not submerge in water or any other liquids
* Check for damage before use, do not use if product or cable are damaged
* Do not stretch, twist or trap cable
* This product is for indoor and outdoor use
* Ensure cable is placed such that no trip, entanglement or strangulation hazards are likely to occur
* Do not attempt to replace the "non-replaceable" bulbs
* This product is for decorative purposes only, it is not suitable for household illumination

**Battery warning:**
Batteries should only be inserted or changed by an adult. Do not use rechargeable batteries. non-rechargeable batteries are not to be recharged. Do not mix alkaline, standard (carbon-zinc) or rechargeable (nickel-cadmium) batteries. Never mix old batteries with new batteries (replace all batteries at the same time). Be sure to insert batteries with the correct polarities and always follow product and battery manufacturers' instructions. Remove batteries from product before extended storage. Always remove old or exhausted batteries from the product. The supply terminals are not to be short circuited. Check that the contact surfaces are clean and bright before installing batteries. Do not bury or burn batteries. Recycle used batteries responsibly. Do not be dispose of with household waste.

products.baseName: Prestige Battery Operated 200 LED String Lights
products.variantName: Prestige Battery Operated 200 LED String Lights - Multi
products.sourceDescription:
These lovely lights will add sparkle to any plant, wreath, tree or anything else you would like to add a twinkle to at Christmas time! There are 200 Ultra bright LED bulbs and with an approximate 20.9m, there is plenty to go around! These lights are Battery operated (requires 3 x 1.5V D Batteries -not included) and once placed and switched on, will operate for 6 hours and then switch themselves off for 18 hours saving energy. You get to sit back and enjoy the twinkling lights on a setting of your choice (there are 8 different light sequences) every night without worrying about switching them on or off!

* 200 LED
* Battery Operated: 3 x 1.5V D (Not Included)
* Total Length: 20.9m (Approx.)
* For Indoor & Outdoor Use
* 8 Light Sequences
* Timer Function
* Energy Saving

This is not a toy, keep away from children and pets during use and assembly. Do not operate in packaging. Keep away from heat source or naked flame. Do not submerge in water or any other liquids. Check for damage before use, do not use if bulbs or cable are damaged. Do not stretch, twist or trap cable. This light set is for indoor and outdoor use. Ensure cable is placed such that no trip, entanglement or strangulation hazards are likely to occur. Do not attempt to replace the 'non-replaceable' bulbs. This product is for decorative purposes only, it is not suitable for household illumination.

**Before first use**
Carefully remove the product from the packaging taking care not to twist or tangle the cable. To insert batteries, unscrew the hook end lid of the battery compartment by turning in an anti-clockwise direction indicated by the arrow. Using the satin loop carefully pull and slide out the battery holder (the battery holder is not removable). Insert 4 x 1.5V AA batteries ensuring you follow the diagrams marked on the holder. Carefully refit the battery holder and secure the lid making sure the waterproof seal is correctly seated. Careful not to twist or strain the wires of the lighting chain during this operation. 
Press the on/off button to turn lights on. Press the function button to go through the 8 different functions. Once they are switched on press the timer button to set the lights to automatically turn off after 6 hours, then back on again after 18 hours. If lights are required to remain ON after 6 hours, press ON/OFF button twice. Remember! This light set can be used indoors and outdoors. 

**Battery warning**
Batteries should only be inserted or changed by an adult. Do not use rechargeable batteries. Non-rechargeable batteries are not to be recharged. Do not mix alkaline, standard (carbon-zinc) or rechargeable (nickel-cadmium) batteries. Never mix old batteries with new batteries (replace all batteries at the same time). Be sure to insert batteries with the correct polarities and always follow product and battery manufacturers' instructions. Remove batteries from product before extended storage. Always remove old or exhausted batteries from the product. The supply terminals are not to be short circuited. Check that the contact surfaces are clean and bright before installing batteries. Do not bury or burn batteries. Recycle used batteries responsibly. Do not dispose of in household waste.

products.baseName: Festive Feeling 6cm Christmas Bauble 20 Pack
products.variantName: Festive Feeling 6cm Christmas Bauble 20 Pack - White
products.sourceDescription:
Transform your home into a warm and inviting festive space with this beautifully curated 20-pack of Christmas baubles. Thoughtfully designed to blend timeless holiday charm with a modern colour palette, this set is perfect for creating a professionally styled tree without the effort. Whether you're going for a classic Christmas look or a more contemporary theme, these baubles provide the perfect foundation for a stunning display.

Each bauble measures 6cm in diameter, a versatile size that works effortlessly on small, medium, and large Christmas trees. They are large enough to stand out individually while still allowing you to layer decorations for a rich, full appearance. The consistent sizing also ensures a balanced, cohesive finish across your entire tree or display.

The set includes a carefully selected mix of six elegant colours: silver, green, red, gold, white, and navy. This combination offers both traditional festive tones and modern accents, allowing you to create a look that feels both classic and fresh. The addition of navy introduces a contemporary twist, while the metallics and traditional hues maintain that unmistakable Christmas warmth.

* Assorted Colour Palette: Includes a balanced mix of silver, green, red, gold, white, and navy, making it easy to match a variety of festive themes.
* Three Stylish Finishes: Each set features a combination of matt, shiny, and glitter (sparkling) baubles for added visual interest and texture.
* Perfect Size: At 6cm diameter, these baubles are ideal for most tree sizes—large enough to stand out, yet compact enough for fuller decorating.
* Durable & Lightweight: Crafted for easy hanging and long-lasting seasonal use.
* Ready to Hang: Each bauble comes with a hanging loop, making decorating quick and hassle-free
